note: The EPO systems report (piece 5A): one line per EPO system. How its columns are called, what its status words mean, and how a system matches a CI. A system matches the Service Instance whose Asset tag is its EPO ID. The fix is always made in EPO; a service mapped CI is then updated in ServiceNow by SACM by hand.

sourceFirst.note: The source first: a people line of these checks on a CI that pairs with an EPO system is compared with EPO before anybody is asked. EPO already names another person: the line waits (SACM copies it, or the sync brings it). EPO is wrong or empty too: the owner is asked, and the line says what EPO holds. A leftover (empty in EPO, a person still in ServiceNow) is asked of the owner; when its person is still active, the line is made on the check named in 'leftover'.

notCompared: The two EPO criticality numbers (scale 1 to 5, ServiceNow uses another scale) and the GDPR marks are not compared.
